title: Adaptive embedding-to-crossencoder routing and regression safety net
creator: Priya Desai
description: Introduce an adaptive routing layer between candidate-embedding producers and cross-encoder rerank endpoints that selects model variant by SLO, language, and candidate pool size. Add a regression safety net (automated checks + rollback gates) to protect quality when upgrading cross-encoder variants or quantization profiles.
acceptance_criteria: Routing policy selects appropriate cross-encoder variant deterministically given (language, candidate_count, latency_budget) and is configurable via Console
End-to-end p95 tail for rerank path meets configured SLO tiers (latency budgets: 40ms/75ms/150ms) for at least 90% of test slices during canary
Regression harness runs on every canary and fails rollout if recall@10 or nDCG decreases by >1.5% for any high-traffic locale
Canary rollout supports automated rollback when regression or latency SLO breach is detected
Operational dashboards show per-variant cost/tokens, p50/p95 latency, and language-specific quality deltas
notes: Motivation: current single-variant rerank causes either cost blowups or latency regressions when switching models. We need a traffic-aware selector plus safety checks to ship cross-encoder upgrades faster.
Design constraints: must not add >10ms median routing overhead; must be purely policy-driven (no ML training in routing).
Primary variants under consideration: CE-base-fp16 (baseline), CE-compact-int8 (low-latency fallback), CE-large-qat (quality-targeted with quant-aware tuning).
SLO tiers will map to customer plans: Free/Dev -> 150ms, Standard -> 75ms, Premium -> 40ms; routing must respect plan-level budgets.
updates: 2026-03-01: Ticket created by Priya. Initial scope scoped to routing layer + regression harness integration. Estimated 8 points.

2026-03-05: Prototype routing policy implemented in sandbox: policy inputs = language tag, candidate_count, customer_tier, recent p95 observed latency (window 5m).

2026-03-07: Regression harness owner (Aisha Patel) added tests: recall@10, nDCG, and embedding drift score. Initial baseline run against CE-base-fp16 completed. Saved baseline artifacts to confluence.

2026-03-09: Canary plan drafted: 2% global traffic, stratified by top 8 locales. Canary fail conditions: any locale recall@10 drop >1.5% OR p95 latency > configured SLO for >5 minutes OR error rate increase >0.5%.

2026-03-10: Runtime team implemented rollout hooks and automatic rollback API; integration tests green on CI job rerank-routing-integration (link below). Begin scheduling limited canary for next week.
